object_description: three-level comb composition with six mono-oriented branches
design_condition: The comb extends toward the Jura, organizes access and delivery along the site perimeter, and places sports facilities in the remaining edge and interstitial spaces.

positive.statement: The implementation responds to the context in an orderly manner through differentiated access, a linear delivery yard, and carefully positioned sports facilities.
The project is precisely subordinated to the monumental neighbouring construction.
The original clarity remains and continues to respond through numerous solutions addressing the observations from the first degree.
The detailed study of the individual cells is interesting.

negative.statement: The system suffers from a significant spread between the divisions and the administrative unit, which is eccentric in relation to them.
The concentration of the division program and addition of a median connection disrupt the initial simplicity of the concept.
The courtyards are simultaneously open and closed without providing real additional spatial qualities.
Views from the cells and common areas are dominated by the sports facilities, with substantial associated noise.
The undulating intermediate connection is difficult to understand and provides no decisive spatial qualities.
The intermediate connection makes routes between flows complex because vertical and horizontal intersections require automated management.
